svg.title: Figure 3-1. LD-SDA element hierarchy (WP-C-01 §2.1, §3.1, §3.2)
svg.desc: The item LD-SDA realizes the functions F-01 to F-09. It consists of one system: sensors, controllers and an actuation output, whose actuators (EPS, ECM/PCM, ABS/VSC) are existing vehicle elements outside the item, reached through IF-01 and IF-02. The system consists of five components: E-04 device hardware, E-05 harness, E-03 safety MCU firmware, E-01 application SoC software and E-02 ML models. E-06 external compute is excluded pending OI-4. Each component consists of hardware parts or software units: E-04 of the SoC, panda MCU, cameras, IMU, GNSS, display, speaker, CAN transceivers, power supply and enclosure; E-05 of the harness wiring and intercept relay; E-03 of the panda firmware and the opendbc Toyota safety mode; E-01 of 23 openpilot processes; E-02 of the driving model and the driver monitoring model. E-01 and E-02 run on the SoC, E-03 on the panda MCU.
svg.text: Item → system → components → hardware parts and software units, after ISO 26262-1:2018 3.39 (element) · functions realized by the item
sensor → controller → actuation output; the actuators themselves are existing vehicle elements outside the item
LKA torque · ACC accel · LKA HUD

Element (ISO 26262-1 3.39): a system, component, hardware part or software unit. A system has at least a sensor, a controller and an actuator; here the actuators are existing vehicle elements commanded through IF-01.
